Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of
neck pain, stiffness, and headache radiating into the upper shoulders. The reported
mechanism of injury is consistent with the kind and force of the impact, and the
presenting symptoms fit that pattern. Over the course of 29 visits, the patient
received conservative care including manaul therapy, supervised therapeutic exercise,
and home exercise instruction. Treatment followed a typical clinical progression, with
visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and range of motion returned toward
normal. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the cervical injury.
The patient reported a remote, minor strain in the same region some years earlier,
which resolved completely without lasting limitation. Billing records reflect single,
appropriate charges for each service, with no duplicated entries. Current status is
improved, with residual mild stiffness and a plan for discharge to self-directed
exercise.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
